author: KEXP
description: With a noise rock sound that finds itself constantly evolving, the Bangkok-based outfit Hargiuem Zaboy refuse to be bound to one thing. Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival, the longtime friends deliver a performance of "Whoa!!!" and more.
title: Hargiuem Zaboy performs "Whoa!!!" & more Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival

author: KEXP
description:
